description: The live quorum feed, newest first. A quorum is one news story split into the distinct viewpoints being expressed about it: each viewpoint has a label, a summary and a support_count of the posts behind it, split into media, socials and iwitness (on-the-ground reports). Filter by country; page with cursor. Costs $0.01 per quorum returned; an empty page is free. Needs the Quorumz API key on this connection (Authorization: Bearer <key>); the first 100 calls within 7 days are free.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. LB. Omit for the whole world.
country.title: Country

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous page, to read older records. Omit for the newest.
cursor.title: Cursor

limit.description: Records per page, 1 to 50. Every record returned is charged.
limit.title: Limit
